presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: at 1:1 the focus card carries its 50-character state as its last line, so it is narrow and very tall; the lens that magnifies it >= 1.5x beside the stepped-back context cannot reach 0.37 of the short side, and the crop under the leftmost card reached the presenter (lens-crop-person); five near-maximum cards also overflowed the table (ledge-width). Tried before capping: wide (beside) and stacked lens; step-back targets 0.42/0.40/0.37; lens crop taking whole neighbour cards or narrowing to the gaps; zoom up to the supplied 2.6; the presenter further from the table (homeDrop 120); room width search; text column and band panels; another focus item alone (still lens-small). Rendered BEFORE (capmeasure, hold): 16:9 16.4 px / 95.5 px, 9:16 16.4 / 107.3 (lens-crop-person), 1:1 16.4 / 69.6 (ledge-width, card-text, lens-crop-person, lens-small). AFTER the cap (state values 29/30 characters, focus on the second item, 5 -> 4 items of 34-42 characters, participant labels 38-41): 16:9 22.5 / 94.0, 9:16 22.5 / 95.9, 1:1 16.4 / 64.7, every lens check met. The state values stay longer than the baseline ones (10/16); counts stay >= baseline (4 participants, 4 items, 2 exhibits).
